notes.title: NEW introductory video for BUSY one
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We've completely refreshed our English game description page to better reflect our latest content updates.[/p][p]We've also created a brand new trailer for busy players—giving you a quick taste of what makes Beyond the Curtains so captivating.[/p][p]From day to night, from cozy small towns to scenic train journeys—come take a look![/p][p][b]Check out our updated store page now![/b][/p]

notes.title: Content Introduction: Theme 2 "Scenic Journey"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/771d9889ba8ffc9f23c595a11ba4e83e1751d316.gif[/img]

Hello followers,
Let's put aside the April Fool's jokes and take a look at what's really coming to the game!

In "Beyond the Curtains", You can choose between different windows and sceneries. Beyond just fixed windows in buildings, you can also experience... the view from a dining car on a train.

Theme 2 "Scenic Journey" features a window in a dining car. Travel across different regions and enjoy local cuisines along the way. We've already completed sceneries from Taiwan and Canada. Can you guess which landscape this is?

As your journey progresses, a secret will be revealed at the final destination...

Follow us or add to your wishlist to receive updates about the next window!

notes.title: Theme 2: “Blue Depths Restaurant”
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/15c78d7bfdf365307f89b4ce81505c4138eff940.png[/img]

Unlike the small-town landscape of Theme 1 “The Last Leaf”, our new theme features the windows of an underwater structure.

Select this theme and enjoy the spectacle of fish swimming gracefully in the water 🐟🐟. It's perfect for clearing your mind of the daily hustle and bustle.

And what's even better? If you spot a fish you like, simply click on it, and it will instantly appear on your dining table! 😋

With this theme, we hope to raise awareness of ocean conservation 🌏 and promote the philosophy that "freshness equals delicacy" 🍽️

Note: What day is today?

notes.title: Interface and Feature Updates
notes.content:
Hello Players!
In our latest update, we've made the following improvements:

1.Simple Pomodoro Timer
Let this countdown timer help organize your work sessions. We've marked the recommended 25-minute work and 5-minute break intervals with red notches. Features include "pause" and "reset" functions. 
More timer designs are planned for future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/1f3218987feccceb7e5e4d304a046b5547ae6481.png[/img]

2.Always on Top
You can now minimize the window, place it in a corner, and lock it to stay on top of other windows. Perfect for taking quick glances during your work.

3.Interface Updates
We've redesigned how buttons are displayed to prevent them from taking up too much screen space as we add more features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/5f8b70554463a478d9aa575141f5c35a3547883a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/3d34775cad81920a510690f55d80a7c09e4132ce.png[/img]

4.Dynamic Room Objects
Indoor objects will now change as the story progresses. The current version includes two distinct stages.

We are currently developing a new theme in parallel, maybe it will be announced in the next update?
Well, see you next time.

notes.title: Make Your Mark on the World Outside
notes.content:
Hello followers,

Sometimes in our daily lives, the smallest actions can create subtle ripples in our surroundings. A smile exchanged, a brief glance - these can spark little shifts in the cadence of our familiar routines.

In our game, while you can't directly interact with the characters and creatures living beyond your window, a simple click of the mouse allows you to gently influence their behaviors and activities in modest ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/b17be09c68ee24a95b76f70336d67dac26a9ed3c.gif[/img]

Though the room's resident is merely an observer in this cozy community, they remain indelibly connected to the ebb and flow of town life.

Your character may be stuck inside looking out, but the outside world still responds to your unassuming presence, weaving you into the fabric of the neighborhood's unhurried rhythms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/e6e5245ee901adda4c84dc94e26660a280c7b2bc.gif[/img]
(Clicked)

We're excited for you to discover all the understated yet meaningful ways you can leave your mark when peering through that window view into a living, breathing world.

A playable demo arriving this weekend will let you experience it for yourselves. If this tranquil, grounded vignette about simple interconnectivity has caught your interest, stay tuned for more updates on the road to launch!

notes.title: Introducing the Time-Based Game System
notes.content:
Hello followers,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/d2c6713739c5a4f561a4846d820487a89a4c3bf5.gif[/img]

In the trailer footage, you can see swaying curtains and drifting clouds. These are our efforts to represent the "flow of time" in a tangible way.


But it's more than just visuals. As players continually cycle between day and night, time actually keeps moving forward. And the things outside the window will change accordingly...


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/8e1beeeea150ff692fc503372e5bdf2d5aa271f4.gif[/img]

That's all I can share for now without giving too much away! Let me know if you have any other questions as we get closer to launch.

If you like our design approach, let us know. Whether it's introducing our game to friends, leaving a comment, or just a simple like - every bit of engagement lets us know you're beside us on this long development journey. We'd love to hear your thoughts.

notes.title: 5/25 CooMIC Creative Space Exhibition Highlights
notes.content:
We had a blast exhibiting our upcoming titles 'Beyond the Curtains' and 'Alice's World' at the CooMIC 2 Creative Space event this past weekend! Check out some pics from the show floor:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/525584c0f74648653b955eedc6628c15d17d2c19.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/ef33b702f1994dafafd23f288789f5c6a5724c0d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/30f9587003967684f0c4e4c9fa588cc7c5df5f89.jpg[/img]

While the expo was absolutely packed, it seemed like most attendees were glued to their phones instead of checking out the awesome games on display.

You'd think our lofi type work 'Beyond the Curtains' would be perfect to check out while waiting in those long queues. Maybe next time we'll need to set up a giant monitor right in the middle of the line maze and ncourage people to check out 'Beyond the Curtains'. They really need to look up from their phones!

Huge thanks to everyone who did stop by our booth. We were blown away by the positive feedback on both games. We're excited to reveal more details soon more about 'Beyond the Curtains' and 'Alice's World' as we get closer to launch!

notes.title: "Alice's World" Steam Page released, the girl hears "your" voice from in front of the screen
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/bcb8ac1e2aa0c4c98220fb152a0303ecce06e954.png[/img]
Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game.
The girl opens her eyes in a desolate world, and hears "your" voice from in front of the screen.
You can direct her actions, help her solve mysteries, evade dangers, and find a way to leave this place. Of course, you could also choose not to do so, or even worse, deliberately guide her to death... Just kidding, you surely wouldn't do that, right?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439560/Alices_World/
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/b49d52caa40ed999c4231937661499124b6de4ac.jpg[/img]
[h2]【Game Features】[/h2]
[list][*]There is no role-playing! You are yourself, sitting in front of the screen, guiding the in-game character.
[*]Explore the stories hidden behind the desolate world, unravel the truth layer by layer.
[*]Exquisite Japanese-style art and full voice acting bring an immersive experience.[/list]

notes.title: About Animators working with us: Kinseijin Firm Studio
notes.content:
Introducing [url=https://www.facebook.com/KinseijinFirm]Kinseijin Firm Studio[/url]: Your Premier Destination for Captivating Animation

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/b7c5a72c08d9ac3227f8a8e3e049165f008d4add.jpg[/img]

Step into the enchanting world of Kinseijin Firm Studio, where imagination meets excellence. With a passion for storytelling, they have crafted two original masterpieces: "[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oIG_Gvf5HXk&ab_channel=24.5ImageProduction]Kinseijin Love Story[/url]" in 2019 and "[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vF2qDEKD7h8&ab_channel=24.5ImageProduction]Miss Rabbit [/url]" in 2021.

Their dedication to creativity and innovation has not gone unnoticed. they are honored to have received recognition at prestigious events:
BEST SHORT ANIMATION at the Toronto Independent Festival of CIFT 2022
Nomination for BEST SHORT ANIMATION at the Manchester Film Festival 2023
Best Sound Effects at the Screen Power Film Festival 2023
Nomination for BEST SHORT ANIMATION at Phoenix Shorts 2023

Embark on a journey with us as we invite you to experience our latest creation. With adorable artistry and realistic storytelling, Kinseijin Firm Studio brings to life the everyday of our beloved characters. Sit by the window and immerse yourself in their world.
